subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: SS gyn-oncology: ovarian, vulval and GTN staging and therapy

steps.tx: Ovarian masses are triaged with CA-125, menopausal status, ultrasound features, and risk models including **RMI**, IOTA and ROMA. **High-grade serous carcinoma** is the commonest epithelial cancer and links with p53 and BRCA. **Mucinous tumours** demand exclusion of a gastrointestinal primary, while clear cell and endometrioid types associate with endometriosis. **Granulosa cell tumours** secrete inhibin and dysgerminoma raises LDH in young women. Staging uses midline laparotomy with washings, omentectomy and nodal sampling to achieve R0 debulking, with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and interval surgery when unresectable, and frozen section guides extent.
steps.say: When a woman presents with an ovarian mass, the clinician combines the CA-125 level with menopausal status and ultrasound features to estimate the risk of cancer. High grade serous carcinoma is the commonest subtype, and it often carries p53 mutation with a strong link to BRCA. Mucinous tumours always raise suspicion of spread from the gut, so the bowel needs careful evaluation. Clear cell and endometrioid cancers often arise from endometriosis, while granulosa cell tumours secrete inhibin and dysgerminoma raises LDH in young patients. Full staging needs a midline laparotomy with washings, omentectomy and nodal sampling, and the surgeon aims to leave no visible tumour behind.

steps.tx: Epithelial ovarian cancer is treated with **carboplatin and paclitaxel** for six cycles, using weekly dose dense or intraperitoneal routes in selected patients. **Bevacizumab** helps in frontline or recurrent disease with ascites, **PARP inhibitors** maintain remission in BRCA mutated or HRD positive tumours, and mirvetuximab targets resistant disease. **Germ cell tumours** in young women receive BEP chemotherapy with fertility sparing surgery, remembering bleomycin lung injury and dysgerminoma radiosensitivity. Recurrence is judged by the platinum free interval, and blood counts with neuropathy gate each cycle.
steps.say: The standard drug treatment for epithelial ovarian cancer combines carboplatin with paclitaxel for six cycles, and doctors may choose weekly or intraperitoneal schedules in suitable patients. Bevacizumab is added when ascites is heavy or disease recurs, while PARP inhibitors keep suitable BRCA or HRD tumours in remission. Mirvetuximab helps when resistant disease expresses the folate receptor. Young women with germ cell tumours usually receive BEP chemotherapy after fertility sparing surgery, and bleomycin requires lung monitoring. When cancer returns, the platinum free interval guides whether surgery or another drug sequence follows.

steps.tx: Vulvar cancer of **usual type** follows HPV infection in younger women, while **differentiated type** arises on lichen sclerosus in older women, and Paget disease with melanoma stays rare. FIGO staging is surgical, **sentinel node biopsy** serves unifocal tumours under four centimetres, and positive nodes require full groin dissection, while advanced disease needs chemoradiation. Vaginal vault cancers also link with HPV and receive brachytherapy or exenteration, and solid **Bartholin gland cancer** over forty needs excision. Persistent itch or ulcer demands early biopsy, and groin ultrasound helps plan dissection.
steps.say: Most vulvar cancers in younger women are driven by HPV, while older women more often develop cancer on long standing lichen sclerosus. Staging is surgical, and a small single tumour allows sampling of the sentinel node instead of opening the whole groin. When nodes contain cancer, the surgeon removes the groin nodes fully, and advanced disease is treated with combined chemotherapy and radiation. Vault cancers of the vagina behave like cervical disease and respond to brachytherapy, while a solid Bartholin lump after forty needs excision. Any persistent itch or ulcer should undergo early biopsy.

steps.tx: A **complete mole** is diploid and androgenetic with snowstorm villi and theca cysts, while a **partial mole** is triploid and may contain fetal parts. Invasive mole enters myometrium, **choriocarcinoma** spreads through blood to lung and brain, and PSTT with ETT secretes hPL and needs surgery. The **FIGO score** sums age, antecedent pregnancy, interval, hCG level, size, sites and number, plus prior chemotherapy. Low risk disease takes single agent methotrexate or actinomycin, high risk needs EMA-CO, and hCG surveillance with contraception lasts one year, while tubal mole is watched.
steps.say: A complete mole carries only paternal chromosomes, so ultrasound shows diffuse snowstorm swelling with large theca cysts on the ovaries. A partial mole is triploid and can include fetal parts alongside abnormal villi. Choriocarcinoma spreads early through the bloodstream to the lungs and brain, while the rarer PSTT and ETT make hPL and usually require surgery. The FIGO score combines age, pregnancy history, hCG level and spread to guide drug choice. Low risk patients are cured with one drug, high risk patients need multi agent EMA-CO, and hCG is tracked for a year with contraception.

steps.tx: The ultrasound shows an enlarged uterus filled with echogenic **snowstorm pattern** tissue flanked by bilateral multicystic **theca lutein cysts**. This matches the mole step where a diploid androgenetic **complete mole** produces snowstorm villi with high hCG. In the exam, link snowstorm uterus with bilateral cysts to complete mole, and follow evacuation with strict hCG surveillance and contraception for one year.
steps.say: This ultrasound presents an enlarged uterus filled with bright snowstorm tissue and large cysts on both ovaries. The snowstorm pattern reflects hydropic villi of a complete mole, while the cysts reflect very high hCG stimulation. Such a picture requires suction evacuation followed by strict hCG surveillance. Contraception remains mandatory for one year because a rising hCG indicates persistent trophoblastic disease.
